description: Release SLO gates for Coven Automations v1, ratified from measured baselines on the supported local profile. Measures are collected by the release certification harness against the exact release artifact; until a measured baseline lands, every gate is provisional and the gate reports 'provisional' rather than passing.

supportedLocalProfile.store: SQLite WAL, single store, one daemon leader

hardGates.description: zero duplicate dispatches for a single occurrence fence, under every injected failure and duplicate-process scenario
hardGates.enforcedBy: conformance invariants (no-duplicate-dispatch-per-fence) over all vectors, scenarios, and randomized operation sequences

hardGates.description: zero silent eligible-occurrence loss: every due slot of an active routine is fenced or visibly explained
hardGates.enforcedBy: conformance invariant no-silent-eligible-occurrence-loss plus doctor finding occurrences.missed-occurrence

hardGates.description: zero false success under injected failures: a run never reads succeeded unless the runtime outcome was observed and delivery committed
hardGates.enforcedBy: conformance invariant no-false-success-under-injected-failure over all fault-injection vectors

hardGates.description: bounded recovery latency and bounded resource growth over retention windows
hardGates.enforcedBy: conformance invariant bounded-ledger-growth plus restart.recovery-latency and growth measures on the release artifact

measurement.when: release certification (scripts/agent-check full with COVEN_BIN set, and the release pipeline)
measurement.how: the load harness drives the exact release artifact under the supported local profile, emits {measures:[{id,value}]} as JSON, and the runner gate evaluates it: node conformance/automations/runner/conformance.mjs --profile all --slo <measured.json>
measurement.ratification: gates are ratified when a measured baseline lands on the release artifact; gates then move from provisional to enforced in CI
